avis.texte: Avene products in general are great for my skin. Hydrance rich is good but tolerance control is better. I till need to use a moisturizing serum with this cream.

avis.titre: Great moisterizer at a reasonable price
avis.texte: I really love this moisterizer - I primarily use it for my neck and chest at night. My skin stay much more hydrated. This cream comes at a reasonable price point and performs better than much higher priced options.
I really like how it gets absorbed into my skin, feels wonderful. No greasy feeling.
I have skin allergies and this stuff has been great. It feels so soothing and luxurious on my face.

I used this one night and woke up with chicken skin texture and an under the skin pimple. The fragrance is also very strong for being so low on the ingredient list. Quite disappointed that I cannot return this product or receive a refund. The product is also very small for the price and quality. The texture and scent is no different from most body lotions at American pharmacies.
This cream is the best for my dry, sensitive skin in the winter.
Very hydrating however it broke me out quite badly. I think it was the fragrance; it's a rose-powdery scent. If your skin can handle fragrance you may like this product
I love all of the moisturizers I have tried from Avene; this one is so rich and I love how my skin feels when I use it.

THE BEST moisturizer ever! The feel, texture, and smell are so luxurious. I splurged and bought myself a few items for Christmas. It does not bother my Eczema-prone skin at all. I feel like I'm in a high dollar hotel when I apply it to my skin. It's just wonderful stuff!
It moisturizes my skin without making it oily. My pores are more refined. That's it. That's my forever product.

avis.titre: Wish the SPF formula was still available
avis.texte: I really like this cream as it helps reduce redness, I just wish they continued to carry the formula with SPF.
Worth every penny! This will forever be my favorite moisturizer - and I've tried plenty!

After being on Accutane, I've been on the hunt for the past several years for a balm that would help with my incredibly dry lips. This is a nice product, but not more effective than any other balm I've used.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: This face lotion goes on so smoothly and moisturizes my face all day. It leaves my face so soft. Totally love it.
It brings back your skin barrier to life. Love this new skin care product into my routine
This lotion has helped tremendously with the dryness on my face.

This is the best cream I've ever used for a daily moisturizer. It has a rich consistency and never irritates my eyes. It goes on beautifully and the price is right! I order two at a time so I don't ever run out.
Thought it was great at first, but then my skin started breaking out like crazy. Had to discontinue.

Truly a rich hydrating cream without a heavy feel for my skin. I use after swimming. I love to use in combination with your other products- serum and the oxidation one. The texture is rich without being too heavy and clunky so I can add those other products WaHoOTLeS!

It's an alright basic moisturizer. Looks nice when first applied but soon becomes greasy after an hour or 2 even on my dry skin and in colder weather. Fragrance is strong and unnecessary. Wish it was a richer texture - it's extremely light like a lotion and not what I'd expect from a rich cream. While my skin doesn't feel tight, I wouldn't necessarily call this product hydrating. Can find better moisturizers at a better price that will give you better results.
I love the moisturizer I goes so smooth and makes your skin feel soft Love it

I have been exclusively using only Avene products for my skincare for some months now- I just recently started using this as my moisturizer instead of the Tolerance Crème and while I love love love that one, this one is now my new favorite!!! I'm excited because I feel like it will Be good for winter too. Avene you have a customer for life! This and the milky cleanser have changed my skin :)
Hydrance meets all expectations for moisture without an oily or greasy feel and my skin looks better for it!
By using this product, I hope to enrich the texture of my face. It has always tended to dryness and as I age, it becomes more pronounced. I'm hoping this product will help moisturize it.
Awesome hydration, restoring the moisture and texture of my dry skin. I recommend and will buy again.

Spread this kinda thick cream on your face after hydrating with both a spritz of Eau Thermale followed by some drops of Hydrance and folks will comment on your glowing skin. A treatment that makes your face feel great, moist and alive.
This product melts into my skin and leaves me with such a nice glow, love it!!!
Just like the name states, RICH. Feels so nice and luxurious but not heavy and thick. Great moisturizer for my dry very sensitive skin.

First the good: It feels great on the skin and doesn't irritate my HYPER-sensitive skin. I would say about 90% of face products I try - including those labeled as being for sensitive skin - burn when I apply them after cleansing, This did NOT burn. And it works nicely under makeup. The 'not-so-good: The only reason I took a star away is because there is added fragrance! Why do they add fragrance to these products??
I have extremely dry, sensitive skin made worse by eczema/psoriasis. Although this helped with the dryness, it caused me to break out.
I used an entire bottle and this moisturizer clogged my pores and broke me out. Might be the shea. Switched back to Cleanance line and my inflammation significantly reduced overnight.

I have rosacea, acne prone, superrrr sensitive skin. Like everything makes my skin freak out. This is a miracle product. It keeps my skin so hydrated (with no breakouts) during these dry winters and summers in utah. Amazing product. I dont see myself switching moisturizer for a long long time. The tube does seem small, but you just need a tiny amount so this tube should last a while.

I have rosacea, acne prone, superrrr sensitive skin. Like everything makes my skin freak out. This is a miracle product. It keeps my skin so hydrated (with no breakouts) during these dry winters and summers in utah. Amazing product. I dont see myself switching moisturizer for a long long time. The tube does seem small, but you just need a tiny amount so this tube should last a while.
Love this for my face! Not greasy, but moisturizing. Wish it came in a larger size!
I was concerned because some of the reviews complained of the smell- it does have a scent, but I like it. Works well.
Mediocre performance for dry skin and sub-zero winters/cold spring.
I use this product in the evening. Every evening!! Love this product!!
Very happy with this Hydrance Rich cream. A little dab goes a long way, such a comfortable feel for my aged skin.
This product turned out to be just what I needed to moisturize under my makeup. The only improvement I see would be some sunscreen incorporated into it.
Should be fragrance free. Nice product but ruined by heavy fragrance.

This moisturizer is definitely in my top 2. Works wonders for dry sensitive skin especially during the colder months. My only criticism is the fragrance. It's too old lady perfume-ish however, I will say, the fragrance doesn't last long. it goes away in a few minutes. I love the price for a product that works so well for my dry, dehydrated, sensitive skin. Any excess get rubs into my hands as well. Definitely a product I will be buying many more times.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer but smell is strong
avis.texte: It's a nice moisturizer with great consistency and hydration. The smell, however, is very strong, which makes me think there are unnecessary ingredients. It's early so maybe I'll get used to it but that is my initial reaction.

Moisturizes great, but the smell is very strong and potent where I'd only wear it at night. My husband likes to use this as well because he has sensitive skin and really dry skin, but he hates walking around smelling of potent floral.
This cream is incredible! So hydrating! My skin is soft and supple immediately after I use it.
I have used numerous high end moisturizers but none have treated my skin as this does. immediately I can feel it working and the hydration is AMAZING. the smell is fabulous
I wanted to try this cream as I am so pleased with the cleansers and so far I really like it. I am no sure it will last 60 days.
I love this cream but it is too small on size. I actually think that about all the facial moisturizers. If there was more in a tube I would give a higher rating. You
I am seeing wonderful results for my dry, sensitive, and red skin. A little goes a long way too!
Love the product, really helps with dry skin. In addition, makeup goes over easily and looks great!
I can't say whether this product works or not I had to send it back because it smelled so horrible. I'll give it a 3 because of the terrible scent

Five stars for product quality and performance. It has all the qualities I was searching for. It is rich, ultra hydrating, thick and goes on smoothly. The winters are long and drying in New England. I wanted this as my everyday, go-to moisturizer. The moment I opened it and caught wind of the scent was my usual "oh, no...". I absolutely detest the signature scent of AVENE (yet I love the product!). It is strong, it lingers and frequently can be irritating. Why would company that is know for making products for people with sensitive skin use a horrible fragrance? It is a bitter/floral/old-lady cheap perfume scent. Horrible. I could live with a scent which was subtle, did not linger and fresh. Please consider remaking your signature scent.

avis.titre: So excited until I realized it had fragrance…
avis.texte: I love Avene products. Their thermal spring water and cicalfate balm is amazing. However, this has such a strong fragrance I'm afraid I will have a reaction to it.
Perfect for my skin. Smooth and creamy, fells wonderful. I am 84 years old.

avis.titre: I would define but this product again!
avis.texte: Leave skin supper hydrated. My face has a nice glow after only using it for a couple days

LOVE this cream! Fantastic for hydrating mature skin and it has a wonderful fragrance. Texture is enough to moisturize but doesn't feel heavy or thick. I have already seen a difference in my my skin texture and feel. Size is okay for the price. Highly recommend.

I live in a high desert climate and this Rich Hydrating Cream keeps my face soft and moisturized. I mainly use it at night and when I wake up in the morning my face doesn't feel dry and tight. I have an occasional bout of eczema especially during the winter months and since I've been using Avene's products I haven't had any episodes.
This product is rich and silky so a little goes a long way. My face feels more supple and smooth. I'm a believer!
The creamy texture makes my face feels silky and clean. I have been using Avene products since time immemorial even recommended it to my siblings😊 it's our daily dose of happiness.
Purchased for my daughter. She walks her dog in the snow and loves the way this cream keeps her skin hydrated.
My favorite moisturizer I've ever used, so hydrating and lasts all day! Will continue to repurchase literally forever.

I've used this product in the past and loved it. The last tube I received started pilling when I applied it with other Avene and non-Avene products. Hopefully it's just a one off and it won't happen again.
After trying other brands I finally found one for my skin. I adore it, my skin stays hydrated for more than 12 hours, and what I like the most is that my face doesn't look greasy. i love avene

After years of searching for an every day face lotion that actually worked, I discovered Avene. I love all their products now. I have very dry skin. I use this lotion in conjunction with the rich face cream and a skin oil morning and night. The tube lasts quite a long time as you only need a little to work well. I wish I had discovered it years ago as my skin has never looked better.
My rosacea-prone/perioral dermatitis prone skin loves this. No irritation, no burning, just soothing happy skin! And I do love the light scent.

I think that you changed the formula from what is was when it was in a jar instead of a tube. It's not nearly as hydrating and smooth as it was. I've been using this product for quite awhile now and am very disappointed. 😞. I won't Purchase this again.
Love the rich moisturizer. It's great in the fall and winter when my skin is dry.
This is a nice thick moisturizer. It has a very pleasant texture. Unfortunately, I find the perfume smell very strong and unpleasant.
No other product give me such hydration without burning and Avene always leaves my face a d sensitive eye area feeling a d looking it's best!
I love this product! It moisturizes my dry skin while not making my makeup roll off or run. My skin feels soft and nourished 24/7. It's my go to for flawless skin.
This but absorbing…. Non irritating. Helps with my extremely dry skin.
The BEST cream with sudden weather changes! Helps with any dryness from weather changes during the season as well as help bring the moisture back to what face serums have removed.
It a good day cream but not hydrating enough for a night cream for me.

Expected to be more of a balm like consistency. Applies well leaves skin soft is all I have to say other than not hydrating. After applying layers to make hydration last my skin still dry if I have been out for a while. Will continue to use on hands only.
Very light weight, nice scent and feels natural letting skin breathe! I am saving this guy for winter

Initially received as a sample and my teenage daughter loved it for her perpetually dry skin made worse by daily chlorine, sunblock, and sun. I bought the full size ones after that, and she continues to find this the least irritating and the most hydrating of her moisturizers that she's tried in the past. I typically stick to drug store brands for her, and she isn't aware of the cost difference, but clearly she notices the difference on her skin.

I had horribly dry flaky skin, I got a free sample of this product and was blown away by how instantly my skin felt less tight, softer, and hydrated. I'm now on my 3rd bottle and to me the cost is totally worth it. You only need a dime to nickel size amount.
This lightweight yet super hydrating cream leaves my skin soft and revived.
I love this product. It sinks right in without any greasy or heavy feeling and my skin has never looked better!

My whole family uses this. I use it for my dry middle aged skin after shower, before sunscreen. really moisturizes and makes my skin feel like butter. My teen agers use it with their acne medicine to assist with dry flakey side effect. it's non irritating. and moisturizes well.
This is amazing!! My skin feels so soft and hydrated. Highly recommend
Nice day cream- I'm 61 and need the moisture. I live in Colorado and we have a very dry climate.
Great hydration without being too heavy. Just a little goes a long way. Lasts all day!

This moisturizer did not do well with my sensitive skin. I knew it might not work for me when I first noticed how fragrant it was. I put the moisturizer on and after a few minutes, noticed my cheeks were bright red. My skin wasn't burning or hurting, but my cheeks were red and a bit warm to the touch. I had to wash it off. I do experience rosacea on my cheeks, so maybe a warning to others with rosacea.
I have very dry and sensitive skin, this works great for me. Really great for winter especially.
This is a ver Hydrating moisturizer. Helps my dry sensitive skin. On my 2nd tube

If I were just rating the product, I would give it a 5, but the packaging barely hits the 3 mark. I love this face cream, but it is impossible to remove the cream when the tube is almost empty. You cannot unscrew the cover to squeeze it out, so you are left with either throwing away several days of product, or cutting the tube open and then it dries up. I'm really tired of having to discard unused cream, so I am looking for something similar in another brand. It's too bad that the manufacturer doesn't feel the need to fix this issue - I imagine I'm not the only one that has turned to another brand because of it.
Very moisturizing! Last all day and works great under makeup. Love that it is in a tube also.

I'm going through topical steroid withdrawal and my face/body is very sensitive and cycles from redness to extreme dryness. I need my body to stay hydrated and when I flare, this cream retains my moisture for longer and my face doesn't react to it.
I love this cream! I use it during the day under my sunscreen and at night before I go to bed. Makes my face look fresh and hydrated.
This is the best cream I've ever tried. Has totally cleared dry spots on my face.
Works great as a night cream. I use it around my eyes as well, and no irritation!

I bought this for the warmer weather. I use the Rich Hydrating Cream in the jar for Fall/Winter. I still get the results even though it is lighter. Honestly, I've never been disappointed with any of Avene's products. My allergist recommended a drug store brand for my daughters eczema and instead I bought the pump lotion. She was amazed at the progress. I get asked often about my skin care routine. I highly recommend trying any of their products.
I have very sensitive and dry skin. This product is amazing . Feels great on my skin. Perfect hydration.
This is the only face cream I will ever use again! Perfect hydration for my dry skin without feeling oily.
Too soon to know the future effects. It is a nice smooth face moisturizer. I wish it came in a bigger container for the same price
Irritates my sensitive, reactive skin likely due to the fragrance. Would not recommend for sensitive skin.

I had a sample of this and liked it for how moisturizing it was on my dry face so ordered the full size. It is very moisturizing which I like but it pills like crazy whenever I touch my face after it's on. All I do is wash my face and then apply. No serums or anything under that would make it pill. Even just putting concealer or bronzer on it pills and rubs off my face. I don't plan on repurchasing since half the time I apply some sort of concealer or sunscreen and just can't get past the pilling.
This is absolutely perfect in every way. It sinks in quick, hydrates, moisturizes, and is perfect under makeup. Forever repurchasing!
If you don't like fragrance hard pass. If you don't like the smell of baby powder another pass.

Definitely an excellent product, an accessible price and the best of its ingredients, it does not give you any reaction, especially on sensitive skin like mine. I have tried many creams I have visited dermatologists, I have spent money, time and none knew how to treat my problem. I recommend it above all for people who have rosacea, Avene works for its creators and people who are in charge of this company, thank you very much, you helped me with my problem, I have struggled for years and I am finally fine, thank you!!!

avis.titre: would be great without the fragrance
avis.texte: it moisturizes well but the fragrance is unnecessary and really strong. its irritating to skin and makes my eyes burn

I use this in the evening and I wake up with smooth and hydrated skin. A little goes a long way. It has a light and comfortable scent as I am very sensitive to scents in products. I really have good results with the Avene products. Will continue to use.
I have been using several of your products with good results and now my daughter and granddaughter are using them also.
Really makes a huge difference in the texture and hydration of my skin. After three days you'd think I'd been at a spa for a solid week. Worth every penny.

How all these 5 star reviews on here?!? I bought to replace an $65 facial moisturizer that I loved for a more cost effective brand. After one single use, 10 minutes after applying and laying down for bed, I checked my face and the moisturizer is peeling all over my entire face and bad. I will be returning immediately. There's no way I could apply this in the morning before makeup.
I love this brand I love the moisturizer. I have combination skin and this helps so much with the dryness during winter !

I'm in my mid-40s & have tried many different moisturizers. This is my absolute favorite. It moisturizes without leaving a greasy feeling/look to your skin and my makeup goes on so much smoother. I have dry to oily skin. It keeps my skin hydrated and keeps the oily contained. My only complaint is I wish the scent was lighter.

I use the Hydrance Gel morning and night and am a big fan! However, the Rich Hydrating Cream is ideal for around my eyes, an area that is particularly dry and sensitive. I use both products every day! They are excellent!

I use the Hydrance Gel morning and night and am a big fan! However, the Rich Hydrating Cream is ideal for around my eyes, an area that is particularly dry and sensitive. I use both products every day! They are excellent!
Rich moisturizing cream that keeps my skin happy and hydrated in dry climates and cold winter months.
Rich moisturizing cream that keeps my skin happy and hydrated in dry climates and cold winter months.
